why: Each figure is a long thin blade with a small step near one tip and one straight edge. Options 1, 3, 4 and 5 are the same blade rotated. In option 2 the straight edge is still on the right but the step has moved to the top, which only happens if the shape is flipped.
trick: Note which side of the straight edge the step is on; a flip moves it, a rotation does not.
